In #inc-vtg-hartford, your first report was **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**: "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant. Both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan."

In the meantime, the channel shows the guard was **writing trailer numbers on a clipboard** by hand. Mateo Quiroga reported at 10:44 that six trucks were waiting at the east gate. At 11:03 he said kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. You confirmed both lanes were working at 11:07.

For the postmortem, note that ticket SUP-5380 has an earlier log entry at **08:12** on 3 Aug: "Rebot failed; drivers queueing. Checking conn. now." The log doesn't say who wrote it, so check that before using it as the first report.
